original_caption: UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEMS | The lessons for the United States are much the same  as last year. First, the prevalence and effectiveness of  Groups 1–3 sUAS in Ukraine and elsewhere means that  U.S. forces should be equipped with their own sUASs.  In July 2023, members of the Armed Forces of Ukraine  expressed shock that their U.S. Army trainers had not  even considered, let alone integrated, an sUAS aspect  into their training or into their formations organically.19  Adding such an sUAS would provide an organic RISTA  and offensive indirect fires method directly to the lowest  levels, improving protection of stationary sites, providing  reconnaissance of ground routes and enemy positions,  and providing targeting information directly to fires  assets. And the Army is moving far too slowly.
